name: iacg-status
purpose: One-word health/status/onboarding report: toolchain versions, onboarding state, cache, and missions, with a readiness line. No complex instruction required from the user.
never_do: make the user type a tool action or long instruction
re-warm or re-download the cache when onboarding is CONFIRMED
claim a check passed that did not run

provenance.source_reference: Owner directive I1: a plain word (status/health/onboarding) returns one clean report instead of a complex tool instruction.
